title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and modernize cache parallelism
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Unify and simplify CI workflows: consolidated lint/test/release pipelines, reduced duplication, improved build cache parallelism and hygiene. No runtime API changes.
description:
Motivation: Our CI has accumulated duplicated workflow files across repositories and inconsistent caching/matrix strategies. This causes longer feedback loops, flaky caches, and makes release automation brittle. This PR consolidates lint, test, and release workflows into a smaller, opinionated set that: (1) standardizes Node.js build/test matrices on Node 20, (2) consolidates lint/test job templates to reduce duplication, (3) improves build-matrix cache parallelism and re-use, (4) standardizes release automation triggers and tagging hygiene.

What changed (summary): consolidated `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `test.yml`, and `release.yml` into two workflows: `ci-lint-test.yml` and `release-automation.yml`. Introduced reusable workflow templates under `.github/workflows/templates/` for lint/test steps and cache actions. Updated actions to latest stable versions and pinned hashes for high-risk steps. Tightened job timeouts and improved logging for caching failures.

Checklist: 
- [x] Consolidate workflows and add templates
- [x] Upgrade actions to recommended versions (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4)
- [x] Standardize Node 20 test matrix and reduce cross-matrix duplication
- [x] Improve cache keys and parallelism to avoid thundering herd on CI cache restores
- [x] Run full monorepo test (integration + unit) in PR CI
- [x] Update release workflow to only run on tagged main merges and use release-drafter for notes

Notes: There are no code-level product changes; only CI infra. I ran several test runs on a fork and a branch of the monorepo to validate run time reductions (~20% faster median pipeline on GitHub-hosted runners for common PRs) and more stable cache hits. See CI summary below for flaky job reruns and final green run.

Migration: Repo maintainers should remove legacy per-repo workflows over next 2 weeks. The templates are intentionally conservative to avoid surprises; teams can opt into more aggressive parallelism by tweaking the top-level workflow inputs.

Related: ENG-3121 (CI modernization epic), ENG-3150 (release automation hygiene).
